title: Analysis of titanium-nanotube sphere, later stolen

tellings.quote: And um like that sphere was um a made of a titanium alloy that um had carbon nano tubes also built into the metal which I think provided thrust by the the Bfield Brown effect.

plain: A guest named Steve told podcast host Jesse Michels that he analyzed a sphere recovered in Mexico and studied in the United States, which he says was later stolen. According to him, it was made of a titanium alloy with tiny carbon tubes, called carbon nanotubes, built into the metal. He thinks these let it fly using the Biefeld-Brown effect, an idea that high voltage can produce thrust, which would mean the object had a non-standard way of moving.
